subagent_input.last_assistant_message:
Returned 6 ranked sources via StructuredOutput. Key findings for the ghostty-support angle:

- **Confirmed supported:** Kitty graphics protocol (official docs + discussions). chafa/timg/viu/kitten-icat work via the Kitty path.
- **Confirmed unsupported:** Sixel (maintainer has explicitly declined to add it — Discussion #2496, corroborated by HN). This means chafa's common Sixel fallback won't work on Ghostty; tools must use `-f kitty`/auto-detect Kitty.
- **Known constraints:** No animation frames (#5350); Kitty protocol can fail with temp-file transfer mode vs inline (#5774); libghostty render-state C API does not expose image data to embedders (#12111); chafa+fzf image-clear quirk on exit (#3054).

iTerm2 OSC 1337 support was not definitively confirmed in these results — flagged as uncertain and would need the official docs page (ghostty.org/docs/features) to confirm.
